subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially fill in the circles and to balance the given equation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31eb44b7fc9c5f74494546446587b6c00662b79b963d241f8aeb5ed03e4763db.png]
solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31eb44b7fc9c5f74494546446587b6c00662b79b963d241f8aeb5ed03e4763db.png] 

(1) **÷, ×, -, =, ×**

After putting the signs:

⇒ __**45 ÷ 9**__ × 3 - 25 = 55 × 15

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**5 × 3**__ - 25 = **55 × 15**
